name: Reports Patch
description: An SSM managed instance reports a patch (managed instance -> patch): one DescribeInstancePatches row, carrying that instance's state, severity and install time. The patch node is shared by every instance that reports it (ruling B2). A reference, not containment. Collected by the SSM walk (collectors/boto3_collector/ssm_patch.py, aws-core-tap#281, req-aws-core-ssm-patch-state).

state.description: The patch's state on this instance as DescribeInstancePatches reports it: INSTALLED, INSTALLED_OTHER, INSTALLED_PENDING_REBOOT, INSTALLED_REJECTED, MISSING, NOT_APPLICABLE, FAILED or AVAILABLE_SECURITY_UPDATE. Changes in place run to run; not part of the key.

severity.description: The patch's severity as DescribeInstancePatches reports it for this instance (Critical, Important and so on).

installed_time.description: When the patch was installed on this instance, ISO 8601 UTC; null when it is not installed (AWS reports the Unix epoch).
